Chooses pizza_and_drinks_information_seeker and proposes a mix of presence/availability and consistency rules (or other related checks such as delivery availability or specific margarita-price checks).

result.notes: All non-fallback responses agree the better profile is pizza_and_drinks_information_seeker. Clusters split by the type of proposed rule changes: presence/availability checks, consistency-across-conversations checks, or a mixture of both. Several responses in the mixed cluster include one presence rule and one consistency rule or add related checks (e.g., delivery or margarita-specific rules).
